'''August 2000 Marlton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Marlton, NJ on 6 August 2000. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1092">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-06-marlton-nj-6-aug-00d1092/ marlton-nj-6-aug-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 6 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-06-marlton-nj-6-aug-00d1092/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Marlton, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 28
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Praskac]]<ref name="tr-d1135" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Praskac]]<ref name="tr-d1135" />

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Pete Flamini Mt. Laurel NJ 8-6-00 (tournament report)]] — by [[Pete Flamini]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Pete Flamini's report is titled Mt. Laurel, NJ; Doug Faust's reports place the same 6 August 2000 event in Marlton (at Great Traditions). The two townships adjoin.<ref name="tr-d1135" />
